gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.intro: AnyMark is an AI-powered Chrome bookmark manager with a conversational agent. Manage, search, and organize your bookmarks through natural language — like chatting with a friend. It's 100% free, open source, and respects your privacy.

feature1.title: AI Agent
feature1.desc: Chat with your bookmarks using natural language. Search, organize, and discover — all through conversation.

feature2.title: Smart Save
feature2.desc: One-click save with AI-powered auto-tagging, categorization, and folder suggestions.

feature3.title: Multi-Provider
feature3.desc: Bring your own API key. Supports OpenAI, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, and more.

feature4.title: Keyboard First
feature4.desc: Full keyboard navigation with Vim-style shortcuts for power users.

installation.title: Installation
installation.step1: Visit the AnyMark page on the Chrome Web Store.
installation.step2: Click "Add to Chrome" and confirm the permissions.
installation.step3: AnyMark icon appears in your toolbar — click it or open the sidebar to get started.
installation.manual1: Download or clone the repository from GitHub: github.com/Johnny-xuan/Anymark
installation.manual2: Run npm install && npm run build inside the smart-bookmarks folder.
installation.manual3: Open chrome://extensions, enable Developer Mode, and click "Load unpacked".
installation.manual4: Select the smart-bookmarks/dist folder. The extension is now installed.

aiAgent.title: AI Agent
aiAgent.intro: AnyMark's AI Agent lets you manage bookmarks through natural conversation. Type a question, give a command, or use slash commands for quick actions. The agent understands context and can chain multiple operations together.

find.desc: Search bookmarks and folders by keyword

ls.desc: List contents of the current directory

tree.desc: Show folder structure as a tree

aiAgent.nlDesc: Beyond slash commands, you can simply describe what you need in plain language. For example: "Find all my Python tutorials", "Move React bookmarks into a Frontend folder", "Delete duplicates", or "What are my most visited sites?" The agent parses your intent and executes the right tools automatically.
aiAgent.toolsDesc: The agent operates through a Unix-style command system. When you chat naturally, the AI translates your intent into these commands automatically:

tool.ls: List bookmarks and folders in the current directory
tool.cd: Navigate into a folder (supports relative and absolute paths)
tool.find: Search bookmarks by keyword, tag, or URL pattern
tool.tree: Display the full folder hierarchy as a tree
tool.mv: Move or rename bookmarks and folders
tool.cat: Show detailed info about a specific bookmark
tool.open: Open a bookmark URL in a new tab
tool.cp: Copy a bookmark to another folder
tool.stat: Display metadata and statistics for an item

smartSave.title: Smart Save
smartSave.intro: Smart Save lets you bookmark any page with a single click. AnyMark's AI automatically analyzes the page content and generates tags, a category, a folder suggestion, and a brief summary — so you never have to organize manually.
smartSave.step1: Click the AnyMark icon in the toolbar or use the right-click menu → "Save to AnyMark".
smartSave.step2: AI analyzes the page title, URL, and content to generate tags, category, and folder suggestion.
smartSave.step3: Review the AI suggestion in the popup, edit if needed, then confirm. Done!

multiProvider.title: Multi-Provider AI
multiProvider.intro: AnyMark supports multiple AI service providers. Bring your own API key and choose the model that fits your needs and budget. All API requests go directly from your browser to the provider — AnyMark never proxies or stores your data.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.models: Llama 3, Mistral, Qwen, and any local model

multiProvider.setupDesc: Open Settings → AI Settings, select your provider, paste your API key, and click "Test Connection" to verify. You can add multiple API keys for automatic rotation — if one key hits a rate limit, AnyMark seamlessly switches to the next.

chromeSync.title: Chrome Sync
chromeSync.intro: AnyMark integrates with Chrome's native bookmark system so your data stays consistent across the browser and the extension.
chromeSync.bidirectionalDesc: When enabled, any bookmark you add, edit, or delete in AnyMark is instantly reflected in Chrome's native bookmarks — and vice versa. Changes made in Chrome's bookmark manager automatically sync back to AnyMark. On first enable, existing bookmarks are merged (union) with deduplication.
chromeSync.cloudDesc: AnyMark can also sync your settings (AI configuration, UI preferences, custom rules) across devices using Chrome's built-in sync storage. This uses your Google account — no third-party servers involved. Go to Settings → Cloud Sync to enable.

q1.q: Is my data safe? Where is it stored?
q1.a: All bookmark data is stored locally in Chrome's extension storage on your device. Your API keys are encrypted and stored locally — they are never sent to AnyMark servers (there are none). AI requests go directly from your browser to your chosen provider.

q2.q: Do I need an API key to use AnyMark?
q2.a: An API key is required for AI features (smart save, AI agent, auto-tagging). You can still use AnyMark as a regular bookmark manager without one. For a free option, use Ollama to run AI models locally on your machine.

q3.a: AnyMark supports any provider compatible with the OpenAI API format: OpenAI, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, Anthropic Claude, Ollama (local), and many more. See the full list in Settings → AI Settings.

q4.a: Basic bookmark management (browsing, searching, editing, keyboard shortcuts) works fully offline. AI features require an internet connection — unless you're using Ollama with a locally running model.

q5.q: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
q5.a: Open an issue on our GitHub repository: github.com/Johnny-xuan/Anymark. We welcome bug reports, feature requests, and pull requests.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: AnyMark ("the Extension") is an open-source Chrome extension for AI-powered bookmark management. This privacy policy explains what data we access, why, and how it is handled.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.desc: AnyMark does NOT collect, transmit, or store any user data on external servers. There is no analytics, no telemetry, no tracking, and no user accounts. All data remains on your device within Chrome's local extension storage.

permissions.title: Chrome Permissions
permissions.intro: AnyMark requests the following Chrome permissions. Each is used solely for the feature described:
permissions.bookmarks: Core functionality — read, create, update, and delete Chrome bookmarks to provide bidirectional sync between AnyMark and Chrome's native bookmark manager.
permissions.storage: Store extension settings, bookmark metadata (tags, categories, summaries), chat history, and user preferences locally on your device.
permissions.tabs: Read the URL and title of the current tab when you use the "Smart Save" feature to bookmark the active page.
permissions.activeTab: Access the active tab's page content only when you explicitly trigger AI analysis (e.g., click "Save to AnyMark"). Never runs in the background.
permissions.sidePanel: Display AnyMark's main user interface in Chrome's built-in side panel.
permissions.notifications: Show non-intrusive desktop notifications for bookmark save confirmations and AI analysis completion.
permissions.scripting: Inject content scripts for Pixel Buddy (the animated character overlay) and toast notifications on web pages.
permissions.contextMenus: Add a "Save to AnyMark" option to the browser's right-click context menu for quick bookmarking.
permissions.alarms: Schedule periodic tasks such as automatic bookmark sync with Chrome.
permissions.history: Access recently visited pages to display them in the "Recent" filter tab inside the sidebar.
permissions.favicon: Retrieve and display website favicons (icons) next to bookmarks for visual identification.

hostPermissions.title: Host Permissions
hostPermissions.allUrls: AnyMark requests <all_urls> host permission to enable the Smart Save feature on any website you visit. This permission is only exercised when you explicitly trigger a save action — never passively or in the background.
hostPermissions.apiEndpoints: The extension connects to AI provider API endpoints (e.g., api.openai.com, generativelanguage.googleapis.com, api.deepseek.com, or your local Ollama instance) only when you use AI features. These requests go directly from your browser to the provider you configured — AnyMark does not proxy or intercept them.

dataHandling.title: Data Handling Principles
dataHandling.localStorage: All bookmark data, metadata, and settings are stored in Chrome's local extension storage on your device.
dataHandling.apiKeys: Your API keys are encrypted and stored locally. They are never transmitted to AnyMark developers or any third party.
dataHandling.noTracking: Zero analytics, zero telemetry, zero tracking. We do not collect any usage data whatsoever.
dataHandling.aiRequests: AI requests are sent directly from your browser to the AI provider you selected. AnyMark does not operate any proxy servers.
dataHandling.chromeSync: If you enable Cloud Config Sync, your settings (not bookmarks) are synced via Chrome's built-in sync storage, which is tied to your Google account.
dataHandling.openSource: AnyMark is fully open source (MIT License). You can audit every line of code at github.com/Johnny-xuan/Anymark.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.desc: When you use AI features, your bookmark titles, URLs, and (optionally) page content snippets are sent to the AI provider you configured (e.g., OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek). These requests are governed by the respective provider's privacy policy and terms of service. AnyMark does not add any additional data to these requests.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.desc: Since all data is stored locally, you have full control. You can export, delete, or reset all AnyMark data at any time from Settings → Data Management. Uninstalling the extension removes all stored data from your device.

contact.title: Contact
contact.desc: For questions or concerns about this privacy policy, please contact us at anymark2025@163.com or open an issue on GitHub: github.com/Johnny-xuan/Anymark. You can also reach us on X: x.com/JohnXuann.
